# Feature definition reference

The policy comes from the requested interface behavior: feature capability is separate from
creation and loading. Ways of defining models have crystal-structure, magnetic-structure and
experiment parts, each with an Application, Python and Command Line column. Magnetic manual
creation is planned in every interface and magnetic structures have no COD route.

The command line currently defines models by loading saved projects. Other creation/loading
routes are unavailable there; magnetic manual creation remains planned. The gate observes
actual executable help before checking those claims.

The native CLI is resolved beside the selected compiled Python artifact, or supplied by
`EDI_NATIVE_CLI`, so local app and core CI configurations select their matching executable.

`page.py` parses the built HTML without executing scripts or loading a resource. It identifies
rendered status glyphs from the page's legend, then compares table cells with those glyphs;
changing an accessible label alone cannot disguise an unchanged partial mark. Only explicit
labels naming missing work permit partial marks outside definition tables. The partial legend
must not describe prepared-project restrictions.
# Partial explanations

Every partial cell, including Application and Python definition cells, must identify specific
unfinished work. The authored page can add absent, generic or specific explanations in either
definition column; the same checker rejects the first two and accepts the specific explanation.
Table shape does not establish every Application or Python capability claim.
